title: HLSE Scan Summary
description: The final line emitted by `hlse_core --json scan <dir>` — a rollup of all findings in the scanned directory tree.

threats.description: Number of findings with score >= fail_threshold.

gate_hits.description: Number of findings that crossed the fail threshold (triggers non-zero exit code).

fail_threshold.description: Score threshold used to determine gate_hits (default 60; overridable with --fail-above).

asset_classes.description: Count of distinct asset classes detected (cloud, code, infrastructure, …).

blast_radius.description: Highest-priority asset class label summarising combined exposure (e.g. 'cloud-infrastructure').

immediate_action.description: One-line response directive for the highest-severity finding class. Present when threats > 0.
